scope: 310 frozen PY310 rules;2875 tracked Django Python files;new baseline distinct from historical2874

manifest.worker_source_policy: original saved stable build identity retained; never relabeled as current HEAD
manifest.collector_policy: existing isolated benchmark collector, actual child wait4 resources; original compilation provenance unavailable, executable bytes pinned

django.python_source_subset: all tracked .py/.pyi files; non-Python formats excluded explicitly
django.historical_comparability: new full 2875-file baseline includes the intentional syntax-error fixture; no speedup inferred against historical 2874-file valid-source measurements

manifest.cache_lifecycle: Each cold pair owns new absent ryo-cache and ruff-cache paths. Ryo uses WorkerState::Retained/cache:path, never cache:null. Ruff uses enabled --cache-dir, never --no-cache. No cache directory is reused across cold pairs. OS page cache uncontrolled.
manifest.workers: Ryo local benchmark adapter uses WorkerPool(1); both child environments set RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1
manifest.timing_policy: No correctness/build processes active; take the shared build lock for the performance pair; record uptime/load before and after each child; collector startup/serialization excluded by existing harness
manifest.initial_run_policy: one bounded cold pair, 600s per child by default, preserve signal/partial-report status; not six-sample statistical parity evidence
manifest.diagnostics_policy: separate diagnostic-ryo/profile-ryo runs with independent empty caches and the identical frozen profile, target and file inventory; never overlap timed execution

cold.report_policy: All bounded/failed/unequal outcomes retained. No parity or speedup claim from incomplete or mismatching reports.

coarse.cache_lifecycle: fresh absent retained cache; same profile/selection/target/source inventory as cold measurement

frames.attribution_scope: First up to60seconds of a fresh 310rule/2875file process; cappedprefix does not establish whole-corpus distribution.
frames.phase_progress: No separate phase/rule-file events enabled. Timed and sampled normal run-ryo emitted no complete report; do not infer processed-file counts from retained cache entries.

limitations: One bounded cold pair is not a median
Ryo600-second censored run has no complete report or native resource observation;collector dropped signal observations
60-second CPU profile describes only initial prefix;no corpus-wide hotspot distribution
OS page cache uncontrolled;both tool caches genuinely absent
No correctness or performance parity certificate
